简体中文/zh-US.html.title: 简体中文
简体中文/zh-US.html.body:
🎬 短剧APP使用教程（用户端）

  📱 平台信息
  🔗 APP客户端： https://h5.lollipop.im/
  📱 系统名称： Lollipop 短剧平台
  💻 适用平台： iOS、Android APP


📖 目录



🔐 如何注册并登录？
💰 获取积分的途径有哪些？
👑 怎么才能获取会员？
🔄 怎么使用积分兑换LOL？
💸 怎么提现？






1. 🔐 如何注册并登录

  💡 提示：支持多种注册方式，选择最适合您的方式快速开始！


1.1 选择注册方式

  



1.2 使用 Sign in with Google 进行注册

  🔸 步骤： 选择 Sign in with Google



  


📌 在 Google 浏览器 中打开
步骤 1： 选择确认登录的账号

  


步骤 2： 点击要登录的账号

  


步骤 3： 提示 Login successful 或 登录成功 即表示登录成功 ✅

  



📌 在 非Google浏览器 中打开
步骤 1： 输入您的谷歌 邮箱账号，然后点击下一步

  


步骤 2： 输入您的谷歌 邮箱密码，然后点击下一步

  


步骤 3： 提示 Login successful 或 登录成功 即表示登录成功 ✅

  



1.3 使用 Sign in with Email 进行注册

  ✉️ 支持邮箱类型： QQ邮箱、谷歌邮箱、163邮箱


第一步： 选择 Sign in with Email

  


第二步： 点击 注册，注册您的邮箱账号

  


第三步： 输入 邮箱账号

  


第四步： 设置您的 密码 并再次输入 确认密码，保持一致

  


第五步： 获取您的 邮箱验证码 并输入

  


第六步： 点击 立即注册，提示 注册成功 后即注册完成并自动登录 ✅

  




2. 💰 获取积分的途径有哪些

  🎁 多种方式赚取积分，轻松获得奖励！


2.1 首次注册系统赠送 500积分（限首次注册用户）
注册请参考 如何注册并登录？
步骤 1： 进入 奖励页面

  


步骤 2： 点击 查看记录 即可看到积分明细

  
  



2.2 每次邀请好友奖励 500积分（奖励次数无限）

  ⚠️ 注意： 好友必须注册成功才有效


步骤 1： 进入 奖励页面

  


步骤 2： 点击 邀请 后往下滑动找到自己的分享链接 🔗

  


步骤 3： 有两种邀请好友方式，推荐使用第二种方式，直接点击即可

  


步骤 4： 好友注册完成后，打开积分明细查看积分到账

  



2.3 看剧得积分（会员与非会员）

  📺 看剧得积分规则
  👤 普通用户： 每分钟获得 10积分
  👑 会员用户： 每分钟获得 20积分（2倍奖励）


只要带有计时器的视频都可以看剧得积分

  


当 计时器上 显示 立即获取，积分即已到账

  


普通用户示例：

  


会员用户示例：

  




3. 👑 怎么才能获取会员

  💎 兑换会员规则：10000积分 = 1年会员


3.1 获取会员的方式
步骤 1： 进入 个人中心，点击会员区域

  


步骤 2： 点击 购买，即可 解锁会员！ 🎉

  


步骤 3： 这里可以查看 会员到期时间

  




4. 🔄 怎么使用积分兑换LOL

  💱 积分兑换LOL比例：100积分 = 1LOL


4.1 积分兑换LOL入口
步骤 1： 点击进入 兑换

  


步骤 2： 这里可以看到积分兑换LOL币的比例 100积分 = 1LOL

  


步骤 3： 兑换示例

100积分 = 1LOL
1000积分 = 10LOL
10000积分 = 100LOL

根据您拥有的积分数量输入相应金额

  
  
  




5. 💸 怎么提现

  📋 提现信息
  📱 Metamask下载： https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=io.metamask
  🪙 LOL币地址： 0xc7Ef0284223D188Ccbd71797922946ac0058dFA9
  💵 USDT最低提现数量： 20 USDT
  🪙 LOL币最低提现数量： 100 LOL


5.1 如何找到LOL币
第一步： 进入 Metamask钱包 首页，切换 Base网络

  


第二步： 点击 ➕ 号

  


第三步： 复制 0xc7Ef0284223D188Ccbd71797922946ac0058dFA9 并点击 Next

  


第四步： 点击 Import

  


第五步： 返回首页，看到 LOL 币即表示成功 ✅

  
  



5.2 如何找到自己的接收地址
第一步： 点击 Lollipop Coin

  


第二步： 点击 Receive（接收）

  


第三步： 点击 Copy address（复制地址） 即可获取自己的接收地址

  



5.3 如何提现LOL
第一步： 进入 钱包

  


第二步： 根据图片步骤 切换到LOL

  


第三步： 申请提现成功 ✅

  




  🎉 恭喜您完成教程学习！
  如有任何问题，请联系客服支持

English/en-US.html.body:
Short Drama APP User Guide (User Side)

  Platform Info
  APP Client: https://h5.lollipop.im/
  System Name: Lollipop Short Drama Platform
  Supported Platforms: iOS, Android APP


Table of Contents



How to Register and Log In?
How to Earn Points?
How to Get Membership?
How to Use Points to Redeem LOL?
How to Withdraw?






1. How to Register and Log In

  Tip: Multiple registration methods available. Choose the one that works best for you!


1.1 Choose Registration Method

  



1.2 Register Using Sign in with Google

  Step: Select Sign in with Google



  


Open in Google Chrome
Step 1: Select the account you want to use to log in

  


Step 2: Click the account you want to log in with

  


Step 3: When you see Login successful, the login was successful

  



Open in Other Browsers
Step 1: Enter your Google email address and click Next

  


Step 2: Enter your Google email password and click Next

  


Step 3: When you see Login successful, the login was successful

  



1.3 Register Using Sign in with Email

  Supported email types: QQ Mail, Gmail, 163 Mail


Step 1: Select Sign in with Email

  


Step 2: Click Register to create your email account

  


Step 3: Enter your email address

  


Step 4: Set your password and enter it again to confirm (make sure they match)

  


Step 5: Obtain your email verification code and enter it

  


Step 6: Click Register Now. When you see Registration successful, registration is complete and you will be logged in automatically

  




2. How to Earn Points

  Multiple ways to earn points and get rewards!


2.1 First-Time Registration Bonus: 500 Points (Only for First-Time Users)
Please refer to How to Register and Log In?
Step 1: Go to the Rewards Page

  


Step 2: Click View Records to check your points details

  
  



2.2 Invite Friends: Earn 500 Points per Invitation (Unlimited)

  Note: The friend must complete registration for the reward to be valid


Step 1: Go to the Rewards Page

  


Step 2: Click Invite, then scroll down to find your sharing link

  


Step 3: There are two ways to invite friends. It is recommended to use the second method (direct click)

  


Step 4: After your friend completes registration, check the points details to confirm the points have been credited

  



2.3 Watch Dramas to Earn Points (Members & Non-Members)

  Points Earning Rules While Watching
  Regular Users: Earn 10 points per minute
  Member Users: Earn 20 points per minute (double reward)


Any video with a timer allows you to earn points

  


When the timer shows Claim Now, the points have been credited

  


Regular User Example:

  


Member User Example:

  




3. How to Get Membership

  Membership Exchange Rule: 10,000 points = 1 year membership


3.1 How to Get Membership
Step 1: Go to Profile Center and click the membership section

  


Step 2: Click Purchase to unlock membership

  


Step 3: You can check your membership expiration date here

  




4. How to Use Points to Redeem LOL

  Exchange Rate: 100 points = 1 LOL


4.1 Points-to-LOL Exchange Entry
Step 1: Click to enter Exchange

  


Step 2: You can see the exchange rate: 100 points = 1 LOL

  


Step 3: Example conversions

100 points = 1 LOL
1000 points = 10 LOL
10000 points = 100 LOL

Enter the number of points according to your balance

  
  
  




5. How to Withdraw

  Withdrawal Information
  MetaMask Download: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=io.metamask
  LOL Token Address: 0xc7Ef0284223D188Ccbd71797922946ac0058dFA9
  Minimum USDT Withdrawal: 20 USDT
  Minimum LOL Withdrawal: 100 LOL


5.1 How to Add the LOL Token
Step 1: Open the MetaMask wallet homepage and switch to the Base network

  


Step 2: Click the plus icon

  


Step 3: Copy the contract address 0xc7Ef0284223D188Ccbd71797922946ac0058dFA9 and click Next

  


Step 4: Click Import

  


Step 5: Return to the homepage. Seeing LOL token means success

  
  



5.2 How to Find Your Receiving Address
Step 1: Click Lollipop Coin

  


Step 2: Click Receive

  


Step 3: Click Copy Address to obtain your receiving address

  



5.3 How to Withdraw LOL
Step 1: Go to Wallet

  


Step 2: Follow the steps in the image to switch to LOL

  


Step 3: Withdrawal request submitted successfully

  




  Congratulations! You have completed the tutorial!
  For any questions, please contact customer support

Portuguese/pt-US.html.title: Português
Portuguese/pt-US.html.body:
Guia Completo do Lollipop

  Assista séries, ganhe pontos e transforme em recompensa
  Acesse pelo app: https://h5.lollipop.im/
  Plataforma: Lollipop Short Drama
  Funciona em: Android e iOS


O que você vai aprender aqui



Como criar sua conta
Como ganhar pontos todos os dias
Como ativar o VIP
Como transformar pontos em LOL
Como sacar seus tokens






1. Como criar sua conta (leva menos de 1 minuto)
Você pode entrar de duas formas:
Entrar com Google (mais rápido)

  Passos: Toque em Sign in with Google → Escolha sua conta → Pronto!



Toque em Sign in with Google
Escolha sua conta
Apareceu "Login successful"? Pronto!


Criar conta com e-mail

  E-mails suportados: QQ Mail, Gmail, 163 Mail



Toque em Sign in with Email
Clique em Registrar
Digite seu e-mail
Crie uma senha
Informe o código que chegar no seu e-mail
Finalize em Registrar Agora

Você já entra automaticamente após concluir.


2. Como ganhar pontos

  3 maneiras de ganhar pontos todos os dias!


Bônus de boas-vindas
Criou a conta? Você já recebe 500 pontos grátis.
Confira em: Recompensas → Histórico

Convidando amigos (sem limite)

  Importante: O amigo precisa completar o cadastro para o bônus ser válido


Cada amigo que se cadastrar pelo seu link = +500 pontos

Vá em Recompensas
Toque em Convidar
Copie seu link
Compartilhe no WhatsApp, Instagram ou onde quiser

Quanto mais amigos, mais pontos entram automaticamente.

Assistindo às séries

  Regras de pontuação
  Usuário normal: 10 pontos por minuto
  Usuário VIP: 20 pontos por minuto (o dobro)


Quando aparecer "Resgatar agora", seus pontos já estão disponíveis.


3. Vale a pena virar VIP?

  Regra de troca: 10.000 pontos = 1 ano de VIP


Se você assiste com frequência, vale muito.
Benefícios:

Pontuação dobrada
Mais velocidade para acumular
Melhor custo-benefício a longo prazo

Para ativar:

Vá em Perfil
Entre na área VIP
Toque em Comprar
Pronto!



4. Como transformar pontos em LOL

  Taxa de câmbio: 100 pontos = 1 LOL


Exemplo:

1.000 pontos → 10 LOL
10.000 pontos → 100 LOL

Passo a passo:

Vá em Troca
Digite quantos pontos quer converter
Confirme



5. Como sacar seus LOL

  Informações para saque
  MetaMask: Download
  Rede: Base
  Contrato LOL: 0xc7Ef0284223D188Ccbd71797922946ac0058dFA9
  Mínimo USDT: 20 USDT
  Mínimo LOL: 100 LOL


Como adicionar o token na carteira

Abra a MetaMask
Selecione a rede Base
Toque em "Importar token"
Cole o contrato
Confirme

Se aparecer na sua carteira, está tudo certo!

Como sacar

Vá em Carteira
Escolha LOL
Cole seu endereço da MetaMask
Confirme

Quando aparecer a mensagem de sucesso, sua solicitação foi enviada.


  Dicas importantes
  • Sempre confira se está na rede correta (Base)
  • Nunca compartilhe sua chave privada
  • Sempre verifique o endereço antes de confirmar




  Parabéns! Você concluiu o guia!
  Para dúvidas, entre em contato com o suporte
